title: Grade 6 French — Tue, Jun 02
description: La routine quotidienne — Day 2 of 5: Telling time and parts of the day
subject: french

questions.question: How do you ask 'What time is it?' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Quelle heure est-il?' = What time is it? 'L'heure' = the hour/time.

questions.question: What does 'Il est huit heures' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Il est huit heures.' = It is eight o'clock. 'Heures' = o'clock/hours.

questions.question: What does 'le matin' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le matin' = the morning. 'Le matin, je me lève.' = In the morning, I get up.

questions.question: What does 'le soir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le soir' = the evening. 'Le soir, je me couche.' = In the evening, I go to bed.

questions.question: What does 'la nuit' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La nuit' = the night. 'Je dors la nuit.' = I sleep at night.

questions.question: What does 'Il est midi' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Il est midi.' = It is noon (12pm). 'Midi' = noon.

questions.question: What does 'Il est huit heures et demie' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Et demie' = half past. 'Huit heures et demie' = 8:30.

questions.question: What does 'Il est neuf heures et quart' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Et quart' = quarter past. 'Neuf heures et quart' = 9:15.

questions.question: What does 'Il est dix heures moins le quart' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Moins le quart' = quarter to. 'Dix heures moins le quart' = 9:45 (quarter to ten).

questions.question: Complete: 'Le matin, je me lève à sept ___.'
questions.explanation: 'À sept heures' = at seven o'clock. 'Heures' = o'clock.

questions.question: Which part of the day do you 'prendre le petit-déjeuner'?
questions.explanation: You have breakfast 'le matin' (in the morning).

questions.question: What does 'À quelle heure...?' mean?
questions.explanation: 'À quelle heure...?' = At what time...? 'À quelle heure te lèves-tu?' = At what time do you get up?

questions.question: What does 'Il est sept heures du matin' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Du matin' = in the morning (am). 'Sept heures du matin' = 7 am. ('Du soir' = pm/evening.)
